landing.title: Your World
landing.description: Join Influencers, a community of people just like you! Share your opinion on products and services of brands you love and get rewarded for your participation in online surveys!
landing.benefit1: 500 welcome points when you confirm your email
landing.benefit2: Surveys & polls matched to you every day
landing.benefit3: Redeem points for gift cards, vouchers & PayPal
